title: Research Grant Reallocation uses the technology dialog
description: Research Grant Reallocation: "The elected player gains any 1 technology of their choice. Then, for each prerequisite on that technology, they remove 1 token from their fleet pool and return it to their reinforcements." The elected player was shown a plain option list; they now get the normal technology dialog (filters, roster, tech-skip row) with every technology the engine offers pickable, prerequisites or not. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- GS. Synthetic fixture through a mocked server: a seat owning only Sarween Tools.

shots.heading: Before: option list, desktop
shots.caption: A plain list of gain-<id> options.

shots.heading: After: technology dialog, desktop
shots.caption: Header 'Research Grant'; Hyper Metabolism, Gravity Drive and X-89 are pickable although the seat lacks their prerequisites; Sarween Tools (owned) is not. Confirm reads Gain Technology (Free).

shots.heading: Before: option list, 390x844
shots.caption: The generic list on a phone.

shots.heading: After: technology dialog, 390x844
shots.caption: The same dialog as the Technology card on a phone, with a pick selected.

notes.title: What is excluded
notes.text: Technologies the seat already owns, and faction technologies of other factions. Everything else (all colours, unit upgrades, own-faction technologies) is offered; the engine is unchanged.

notes.title: Fleet tokens
notes.text: The engine removes one fleet token per prerequisite of the gained technology after the pick; the dialog subtitle says so.
